From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Quick security intake — 30m slot + initial artifact list

Hi Tom —

Thanks for taking the time to move this forward. To keep the intake lightweight, can we do a 30-minute sync next week to: 
- walk through the SIG/CAIQ overlap you mentioned,
- confirm the specific log slices you need, and
- agree upload/transfer method for artifacts.

Initial asks we typically surface during intake:
- sample logs (api-gateway, model-inference, auth) — 7–14 days retained, anonymized where needed
- SOC 2 SOC2-type summary or auditor contact (if applicable)
- list of encryption/TLS endpoints and KMS details

I've attached a short guide on how we prepare log samples (redwood-log-sample-guidance.pdf). If you prefer, we can accept staged S3 uploads or a secure transfer link.

Proposed slots (PDT): Tue 6/22 10:00–10:30, Wed 6/23 14:00–14:30, Thu 6/24 09:00–09:30 — let me know what works and we will lock it in.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Security Programs Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: redwood-log-sample-guidance.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Tom Greene <tom.greene@lotushealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick security intake — 30m slot + initial artifact list

Naomi —

Thanks, appreciate the concise list. A couple quick clarifications before the call: 
1) Our retention window for telemetry is 30 days by default; we can send a 14-day export slice if that helps limit PII exposure.
2) We operate in a shared-tenant model for part of our ingestion pipeline — can you confirm whether you need tenant-separated samples or a masked composite?
3) We will need a SOC 2 attestation PDF or point of contact for your auditor.

We can do Tue 6/22 10:00 PDT. I’m copying security@lotushealth.com for any compliance owners who should join.

Also attaching a short internal ask list so we can pre-populate owners (lotus-asklist.csv).

Thanks,
Tom Greene
Director of InfoSec, LotusHealth
Tom.Greene@lotushealth.com

Attachment: lotus-asklist.csv (CSV, 4KB)

Agenda (30m):
- 0:00–2:00 — intros and scope confirmation

Tom —

Thanks for confirming the slot. Quick notes for the intake:
- Tenant separation: if you can provide masked composite samples that include a tenant_id field, that's usually sufficient for us to validate multi-tenant controls without full isolation. If your compliance team insists on tenant-isolated exports we can accept that too — just let us know which tenants and timeframe.
- Retention/export: 14-day slice is perfect. Please gzip the bundles and include a short readme with field definitions.
- SOC 2: Naomi, can you share the attestation PDF before the meeting? If we don't have it on-file the Lotus team will request auditor contact.

I'll upload a short access note with S3 PUT examples (access-instructions.txt) to the provisional bucket and send pre-signed URLs by EOD.

—Ben
